# The Heartbeat Framework

> Deployment risk is capability multiplied by culture. Regulation assesses the first term. This estate instruments the second. Twenty-two open-access records on team psychology for the 24-hour organisation, extended to the mixed human–machine shift. Author: Paul Blatherwick, RMN. Licence: CC BY 4.0 (papers), MIT (code).

## Structure
- Mission: https://heartbeat-framework.org/mission/
- Argument: https://heartbeat-framework.org/argument/
- The Moat: https://heartbeat-framework.org/moat/
- Consultancy & advisory: https://heartbeat-framework.org/advisory/
- Instruments (eight, in deployment order): https://heartbeat-framework.org/instruments/
- Papers (twenty-two records): https://heartbeat-framework.org/papers/
- Implementation: https://heartbeat-framework.org/implementation/
- Developments: https://heartbeat-framework.org/developments/
- Sovereignty: https://heartbeat-framework.org/sovereignty/

## Instruments
- Stage 1 Gate — The Readiness Gate: https://heartbeat-framework.org/instruments/gate/ (record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21445040)
- Stage 2 Screen — The AI Interaction Risk Screen and Change-Over-Time Log: https://heartbeat-framework.org/instruments/screen/ (record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21357450)
- Stage 3 Specify — The Character Specification and Character Vitals: https://heartbeat-framework.org/instruments/specify/ (record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21249771)
- Stage 4 Oversee — Onboarding worksheet, shift card and oversight templates: https://heartbeat-framework.org/instruments/oversee/ (record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21279944)
- Stage 5 Trial — The Floor Test capture sheets: https://heartbeat-framework.org/instruments/trial/ (record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21445071)
- Stage 6 Audit — The Damping Audit: https://heartbeat-framework.org/instruments/audit/ (record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21455540)
- Stage 7 Measure — The AI Interaction Outcome Profile (AIOP): https://heartbeat-framework.org/instruments/measure/ (record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21515932)
- Stage 8 Record — The Glass Ledger: https://heartbeat-framework.org/instruments/record/ (record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21515861)
